item.title: View License Information
item.description: This section describes how to view license information. Prerequisites You need to have the Platform Settings Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Platform Settings Management permissions. In the upper-right corner of the page, click Component Dock > Platform Settings. Click License in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Add License
item.description: This section describes how to add a KubeSphere license. To update a license, follow the same steps below to add a new one. Prerequisites You need to have the Platform Settings Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Platform Settings Management permissions. In the upper right corner of the page, click Component Dock > Platform Settings.
